description.value: Taste of India is a full-service authentic Indian restaurant in Trail, BC offering a broad menu of tandoori specialties, curries, biryanis, and vegetarian dishes, with patio seating and a full bar featuring local beers, wines, and cocktails. The kitchen sources locally produced meats and vegetables and offers a lunch special menu. It is one of two related restaurants in the Kootenays, with a sister location (Cuisine of India) in Castlegar.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms this is an active Indian restaurant at 876 Rossland Avenue, Trail, BC (matching OSM address). The website explicitly states 'open for dine-in AND Take Out,' provides a phone number (250) 512-0084 not present in OSM, and notes over 90% gluten-free and 60% vegan menu items. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears on the website.
concerns: Phone number (250) 512-0084 found on website but absent from OSM tags; added from website.

Several website subpage titles read 'Tandoori Indian Grill & Lounge (Copy)', suggesting the site was built from a copied template — likely a CMS artifact, but the front page and address content clearly match the OSM record.
The website repeatedly misspells the restaurant name as 'TASTE OF INIDIA' in the locations footer, though the front page heading and domain correctly read 'Taste of India'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed open by website content with a full menu, patio, bar, and takeout service at the OSM address in Trail, BC.
